title: New-Coverage Reach of the First Day of Service — Home Oxygen Therapy, by Coverage Class
content:
# New-Coverage Reach of the First Day of Service — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Schedule rule.** When a different coverage becomes primary for Home Oxygen Therapy, the first day of service found from the claim history replaces the effective date only when it is no more than the reach below before the confirmation. The reach depends on the class of the new coverage, read from the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the first day of service is the effective date.

| Class of the new coverage | Reach (days before the confirmation) |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 365 |
| Commercial PPO | 180 |
| Commercial HMO | 180 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 180 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 180 |
| any other class (for example Medicaid Fee-for-Service) | 90 |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical)

| New coverage class | First day of service, days before the confirmation | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 | met |
| Original Medicare Part B | 366 | fails |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 180 | met |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 181 | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 90 | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 91 | fails |

**Which coverage decides?** The new coverage, the one becoming primary.
